1.consolidated_definition: Fruto del quenepo, redondo u ovoide, en racimo, de color encarnado, cáscara débil, carnosidad suave y sabor agridulce; su semilla es comestible si se tuesta.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Fruit of the quenepo tree, rounded or oval in shape, in clusters, with a reddish color, thin skin, soft pulp, and a sweet-and-sour taste; its seed is edible if toasted.

Nota: El quenepo es un árbol nativo de Puerto Rico y América Central.
